## Year Close

Set `year`; `fromMonth` and `toMonth` are January and December. `closes` queries that year's Month Close cards and `accounts` loads the chart. `monthsClosed` counts closes with a `closedBy`, and `netIncomeMinor` sums the year's income, cost-of-goods-sold and expense accounts. Stored: `status` (open, signed off) and `signedOffBy`.

```ts
import { YearClose } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-year';
```

### Operations
- `signOff`: asserts the year is open, sets `status` to signed off and stamps `signedOffBy`. It records who signed off; it does not itself check that all twelve months are closed.

### Non-goals
No closing entry into retained earnings. The Balance Sheet carries prior years' income as its own computed equity line instead.

### Example
`YearClose/2026`, a signed-off year.
attributes.cardDescription: The year-end sign-off: months closed and net income for the year, from the closed months.
